# Code of Conduct

This project is dedicated to providing a safe, inclusive, welcoming, and harassment-free space and experience for all participants, regardless of gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, socioeconomic status, body size, ethnicity, nationality, level of experience, age, religion (or lack thereof), or other identity markers. Harassment in any form is not tolerated.

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) in full.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour to **info@apicommons.org**. Reports are read by the maintainer listed in `MAINTAINERS.yaml`, handled confidentially, and acknowledged within three business days.

If a report concerns the maintainer, say so in the subject line — the escalation path in `GOVERNANCE.md` applies.

## Note on the previous version of this file

Until August 2026 this file was the Stoplight Community Code of Conduct, inherited unchanged with the fork, and it routed incident reports to a repository this project does not control. Those reports would not have reached anyone here. The commitment is unchanged; the address now works.
